papers.title: Long-read genome sequencing resolves complex structural variants in exome-negative developmental and epileptic encephalopathy
papers.translated_title: 长读长基因组测序解析外显子组阴性发育性和癫痫性脑病中的复杂结构变异
papers.author: Park, J.
papers.summary: Background and Objectives: Developmental and Epileptic Encephalopathies (DEEs) encompass a clinically and molecularly heterogeneous group of mainly genetic disorders. Despite standard genetic testing, approximately two-thirds of patients remain undiagnosed. Pathogenic noncoding and structural variants (SVs), particularly complex rearrangements that are difficult to detect or resolve using short-read sequencing, may contribute to this diagnostic gap. To evaluate the diagnostic contribution of long-read genome sequencing (lrGS), we recruited a cohort of 124 families with sporadic DEE who remained unsolved by prior ES. Methods: Trio lrGS (Oxford Nanopore or PacBio HiFi) was performed, complemented zby short-read genome sequencing (srGS) and mRNA sequencing (blood or fibroblast) of index cases, where available. Comprehensive variant analysis included small nucleotide variants (SNVs), indels, SVs, and short tandem repeats. To identify the diagnostic yield of each method, we compared lrGS, srGS and ES re-analysis, and evaluated the additional value of RNA sequencing. Results: We established a diagnosis in 21 of 124 families (16.9%). Fourteen variants were retrospectively detectable in prior ES., Two cases with non-coding variants in SCN1A and RNU2-2 were detectable by both srGS and lrGS. Five SVs also required genome sequencing (5.6% of the total cohort), three of which could be detected, but not confidently resolved by srGS due to breakpoint complexity, repeat-mediated rearrangements, and large copy-neutral events: LrGS enabled accurate characterization of Alu-mediated CDKL5 and STXBP1 deletions and a MEF2C deletion with large inversion. A copy-neutral SCN1A inversion was well characterizable by both srGS and lrGS. One balanced translocation t(X;17) disrupting CDKL5 was resolved by lrGS (srGS unavailable). RNA sequencing confirmed pathogenicity of two SVs including t(X;17), the MEF2C deletion with inversion, and two CNVs. In addition, ZNF569 and ZNF570 emerged as candidate epilepsy genes from our cohort. Discussion: In ES-negative DEE, the incremental diagnostic yield of genome sequencing was modest, while lrGS provided particular value for the structural resolution of complex rearrangements, especially those involving repetitive sequences. The finding that two-thirds of diagnoses were retrospectively detectable in prior ES highlights the substantial value of systematic reanalysis. Further gains from genome sequencing may increasingly depend on improved interpretation of non-coding variation and integration of long-read-specific information. Our findings indicate that complex SVs represent the class for which lrGS currently yields the most distinctive diagnostic information.
papers.translated_summary: 背景与目的：发育性及癫痫性脑病（DEEs）涵盖一组临床和分子高度异质性的、主要为遗传性的疾病。尽管进行了标准基因检测，约三分之二的患者仍未获得诊断。致病性非编码变异和结构变异（SVs），尤其是难以通过短读长测序检测或解析的复杂重排，可能导致了这一诊断缺口。为评估长读长基因组测序（lrGS）的诊断贡献，我们招募了一个由124个散发性DEE家系组成的队列，这些家系在先前的ES检测后仍未获得解答。方法：进行三联体lrGS（Oxford Nanopore或PacBio HiFi），并在可获得的情况下辅以先证者的短读长基因组测序（srGS）和mRNA测序（血液或成纤维细胞）。全面的变异分析包括小核苷酸变异（SNVs）、插入缺失、SVs和短串联重复序列。为确定每种方法的诊断率，我们比较了lrGS、srGS和ES再分析，并评估了RNA测序的附加价值。结果：我们在124个家系中的21个（16.9%）建立了诊断。十四个变异在先前的ES中可回顾性检测到。两例携带SCN1A和RNU2-2非编码变异的病例可通过srGS和lrGS检测到。五个SVs同样需要基因组测序（占队列总数的5.6%），其中三个可被检测到，但由于断点复杂性、重复介导的重排和大的拷贝中性事件而无法通过srGS可靠解析：lrGS使得对Alu介导的CDKL5和STXBP1缺失以及伴有大倒位的MEF2C缺失的准确表征成为可能。一个拷贝中性SCN1A倒位可通过srGS和lrGS良好表征。一个破坏CDKL5的平衡易位t(X;17)通过lrGS得以解析（srGS不可用）。RNA测序确认了两个SVs的致病性，包括t(X;17)、伴有倒位的MEF2C缺失，以及两个CNVs。此外，ZNF569和ZNF570在我们的队列中作为候选癫痫基因出现。讨论：在ES阴性的DEE中，基因组测序的增量诊断率有限，而lrGS对复杂重排的结构解析提供了特殊价值，尤其是涉及重复序列的重排。三分之二的诊断可在先前的ES中回顾性检测到这一发现，凸显了系统性再分析的重大价值。基因组测序的进一步收益可能日益依赖于对非编码变异解读的改进以及长读长特异性信息的整合。我们的发现表明，复杂SVs代表了lrGS目前产生最具特色诊断信息的那一类变异。

papers.title: Common centromeric variation associates with molecular and complex traits in humans
papers.translated_title: 常见的着丝粒变异与人类分子和复杂性状相关
papers.author: Dong, Y.
papers.summary: Human centromeres harbor extensive structural variation that has remained largely inaccessible to human genetics because their repetitive -satellite arrays are absent from standard reference and imputation panels. Here we catalog 188,589 centromeric structural variants (SVs) from haplotype-resolved long-read assemblies of 196 Human Pangenome Reference Consortium individuals aligned to the telomere-to-telomere CHM13 reference. Resolving recurrent SVs into monophyletic components along centromeric haplotype phylogenies makes them imputable from pericentromeric SNPs (mean R2CV = 0.407 vs. 0.065 unresolved). In 124 individuals with haplotype-resolved nanopore methylation, we identify 418 same-chromosome SV-CpG associations that form local hypomethylation-enriched domains in the centromeric region, most strongly for deletions. We also show that a truncated 113-bp monomer on chromosome 8 is associated with the position of the CENP-A-associated centromere dip region (CDR) at n = 151, independent of array length. Imputed into 630 individuals with expression and splicing data, centromeric SVs are associated with 141 genes, 14 of them new relative to the SNP-based cis-QTL analysis, including the H3K9 methyltransferase SUV39H1. In 315,204 All of Us participants, we identify 170 associations between 61 SV predictors and 27 clinical phenotypes, including substance-related disorders and breast cancer. Our study brings a previously inaccessible class of variation into population-scale genetics and links centromeric SVs to centromere organization, gene expression, splicing and complex traits.
papers.translated_summary: 人类着丝粒具有广泛的结构变异，这些变异在很大程度上一直无法被人类遗传学所触及，因为其重复的α卫星阵列在标准参考序列和插补面板中缺失。在此，我们基于196名人类泛基因组参考联盟个体的单倍型解析长读长组装，并将其比对至端粒到端粒CHM13参考序列，编目了188,589个着丝粒结构变异（SV）。将重复出现的SV沿有着丝粒单倍型系统发育解析为单系组分，使其可从着丝粒周围SNP进行插补（平均R2CV = 0.407，而未解析者为0.065）。在124名具有单倍型解析纳米孔甲基化数据的个体中，我们识别出418个同染色体SV-CpG关联，这些关联在着丝粒区域形成局部低甲基化富集结构域，其中缺失最为显著。我们还表明，8号染色体上一个截短的113-bp单体与CENP-A相关着丝粒凹陷区（CDR）的位置相关（n = 151），且不依赖于阵列长度。将插补应用于630名具有表达和剪接数据的个体后，着丝粒SV与141个基因相关，其中14个相对于基于SNP的顺式QTL分析为新发现，包括H3K9甲基转移酶SUV39H1。在315,204名All of Us参与者中，我们识别出61个SV预测因子与27个临床表型之间的170个关联，包括物质相关障碍和乳腺癌。我们的研究将一类此前无法触及的变异带入群体规模遗传学，并将着丝粒SV与着丝粒组织、基因表达、剪接和复杂性状联系起来。

papers.title: Benchmark Self-Triage (BeST): Comparing Self-Triage Systems and Multiple Generations of OpenAI Models Against Preliminary Expert Consensus
papers.translated_title: 基准自我分诊（BeST）：比较自我分诊系统与多代OpenAI模型相对于初步专家共识的表现
papers.author: Kroll, L. E.
papers.summary: As digital self-triage becomes more widely used, quality assurance requires evaluation of both emergency recognition and overall agreement with clinical judgement, including how these outcomes differ across generations of large language models. The Benchmark Self-Triage (BeST) project intends to provide a framework to compare systems for digital self-triage against a medical 'gold standard' in Germany. As a first step in developing and demonstrating the methodology, we compared study-specific implementations of SmED 5.4.11 accessed via API and Infermedica Engine API via Microsoft Azure Healthcare Agent Service with five structured OpenAI configurations spanning multiple model generations: gpt-4.1, gpt-5.4, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.6-sol, and gpt-6-astra. The manufacturers of SmED and Infermedica offer MDR-certified Class IIb triage products, but these certified products were not directly evaluated. An LLM-based patient actor covered 480 physician-curated vignettes derived from German routine triage data. A pool of seven physicians provided preliminary reference classifications and consensus for 480 vignettes. Recommendations were mapped to three urgency categories-emergency, acute, and not urgent-and evaluated using winsorised weights derived from routine triage frequencies. Weighted emergency sensitivity ranged from 51.3% (95% CI 35.5-66.3%) for gpt-4.1 to 99.9% (99.7-100.0%) for gpt-6-astra. Weighted exact three-category agreement (accuracy) ranged from 54.4% to 68.8%; gpt-4.1 achieved the highest agreement despite the lowest emergency sensitivity. No system performed best across all urgency categories. The later-generation OpenAI configurations showed a more precautionary triage profile resembling SmED, with higher sensitivity for emergency cases; gpt-6-astra showed the strongest shift. This cross-sectional comparison across model generations suggests a shift towards more precautionary triage behaviour, without establishing a longitudinal improvement in accuracy. These findings highlight the limitations of overall agreement for evaluating self-triage and support category-specific assessment. Broader expert consensus and evaluation, as well as further steps to reduce dependence on SmED-derived source data, are needed and planned before drawing conclusions about clinical safety.
papers.translated_summary: 随着数字自我分诊的应用日益广泛，质量保证需要对紧急情况识别和与临床判断的总体一致性进行评估，包括这些结果在不同代际大语言模型之间的差异。基准自我分诊（BeST）项目旨在提供一个框架，将数字自我分诊系统与德国的医学“金标准”进行比较。作为开发和演示该方法学的第一步，我们比较了通过API访问的SmED 5.4.11研究专用实现和通过Microsoft Azure Healthcare Agent Service访问的Infermedica Engine API研究专用实现，以及涵盖多个模型代际的五种结构化OpenAI配置：gpt-4.1、gpt-5.4、gpt-5.6-luna、gpt-5.6-sol和gpt-6-astra。SmED和Infermedica的制造商提供获得MDR认证的IIb类分诊产品，但这些认证产品并未被直接评估。一个基于大语言模型的患者模拟者覆盖了480个由医生策划的临床情景，这些情景源自德国常规分诊数据。由七名医生组成的专家组为480个情景提供了初步参考分类和共识。建议被映射到三个紧急程度类别——紧急、急症和非紧急——并使用源自常规分诊频率的缩尾权重进行评估。加权紧急敏感性从gpt-4.1的51.3%（95% CI 35.5-66.3%）到gpt-6-astra的99.9%（99.7-100.0%）不等。加权三分类精确一致性（准确率）范围为54.4%至68.8%；gpt-4.1在紧急敏感性最低的情况下取得了最高一致性。没有系统在所有紧急程度类别中表现最佳。较晚代际的OpenAI配置显示出更为谨慎的分诊特征，类似于SmED，对紧急病例具有更高的敏感性；gpt-6-astra表现出最强的转变。这项跨模型代际的横断面比较表明分诊行为向更谨慎的方向转变，但并未确立准确性的纵向改善。这些发现凸显了总体一致性在评估自我分诊方面的局限性，并支持按类别进行评估。在得出关于临床安全性的结论之前，需要并计划进行更广泛的专家共识和评估，以及进一步采取措施减少对SmED衍生源数据的依赖。

papers.title: Defining and Characterizing Visits To Emergency Departments For Musculoskeletal Conditions: A Retrospective Analysis Using Two Publicly Available Databases
papers.translated_title: 定义和描述因肌肉骨骼疾病到急诊科就诊的特征：使用两个公开可用数据库的回顾性分析
papers.author: Wrightson, J. G.
papers.summary: Introduction There are multiple ways to define and identify potentially avoidable emergency department (ED) visits, making it difficult to estimate their frequency accurately. In this study, we compared the proportions and characteristics of potentially avoidable ED visits identified using three commonly used algorithms. Methods We analysed the publicly available Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV Emergency Department dataset to estimate the proportions and characteristics of potentially avoidable ED visits identified using i) the eventual discharge diagnosis (Diagnosis), ii) the use of hospital resources (Resources), and iii) the triage acuity score assigned to the patient during emergency department triage (Triage Acuity). Results The proportion of visits identified as potentially avoidable differed significantly between algorithms (7 - 36%), and few visits (<2%) were identified as potentially avoidable by all three algorithms. Presenting complaints, discharge diagnoses, and patient demographics were all similarly affected. We found that the proportions and characteristics of potentially avoidable ED visits were affected by the algorithm used to identify them. Conclusion Methods for identifying potentially avoidable ED visits are not interchangeable. Choosing the appropriate definition and classification method will require researchers to carefully consider the types of visits and the characteristics of patients they wish to identify.
papers.translated_summary: 引言 定义和识别潜在可避免的急诊科就诊有多种方法，这使得准确估计其发生频率变得困难。在本研究中，我们比较了使用三种常用算法识别的潜在可避免急诊科就诊的比例和特征。方法 我们分析了公开可用的重症监护医学信息库IV急诊科数据集，以估计使用以下方法识别的潜在可避免急诊科就诊的比例和特征：i）最终出院诊断，ii）医院资源使用情况，以及iii）急诊科分诊期间分配给患者的分诊 acuity 评分。结果 被识别为潜在可避免的就诊比例在算法之间存在显著差异（7-36%），且很少有就诊（<2%）被所有三种算法同时识别为潜在可避免。主诉、出院诊断和患者人口统计学特征均受到类似影响。我们发现潜在可避免急诊科就诊的比例和特征受到用于识别它们的算法的影响。结论 识别潜在可避免急诊科就诊的方法不可互换。选择合适的定义和分类方法需要研究人员仔细考虑他们希望识别的就诊类型和患者特征。

papers.title: Environmental toxic metal exposure and conditional mortality survival among US adults: a prospective cohort study
papers.translated_title: 环境有毒金属暴露与美国成年人条件性死亡生存：一项前瞻性队列研究
papers.author: Fang, X.
papers.summary: Abstract Background. Chronic low-level exposure to lead, cadmium, mercury, and arsenic remains a determinant of premature mortality in the U.S. general population, but previous hazard-ratio analyses do not characterize how exposure shifts the lower tail of the survival distribution, where premature mortality is concentrated. Objectives. We estimated the association of whole-blood lead, whole-blood total mercury, urinary cadmium, and the sum of urinary inorganic and methylated arsenic species with the 10th, 25th, and 50th conditional quantiles of follow-up time to all-cause mortality among U.S. adults aged 40 years and older. Methods. NHANES Continuous 1999 to 2018 was linked to the National Death Index through December 31, 2019 (n = 29,652). Censored quantile regression was fit per metal on the log2 scale at quantiles {tau}{0.10, 0.25, 0.50}. A restricted-cubic-spline (RCS) censored-quantile-regression was fit for blood lead and urinary cadmium to investigate the threshold effect. Results. Over a median follow-up of 9.1 years, 7,215 deaths were ascertained. A doubling of urinary cadmium was associated with -1.57 years of follow-up (95% CI: -2.08, -1.07) at the 10th conditional quantile, -1.50 (-2.04, -0.96) at the 25th, and -1.49 (-1.93, -1.04) at the median (Benjamini Hochberg q < 0.001 throughout). A doubling of whole-blood lead was associated with -0.70 years (95% CI: -0.99, -0.40) at the 10th conditional quantile, -0.62 (-0.92,-0.31) at the 25th, and -0.61 years (-0.89, -0.34) at the median; the absolute loss was largest at {tau} = 0.10 for both metals. Urinary arsenic-metabolite sum was not associated with conditional follow-up at the estimable quantiles. Despite adjustment for dark and fatty-fish intake or DHA/EPA, whole-blood total mercury was associated with longer follow-up (i.e., negatively associated with mortality risk), possibly due to residual confounding by broader dietary or socioeconomic factors, rather than a true protective effect. The cadmium association was additionally robust to the mutual adjustment of lead. Discussion. Low-to-moderate urinary cadmium and whole-blood lead were associated with fewer years of follow-up survival at the lower-tail and median conditional quantiles of survival, with the largest absolute losses at the lower tail of the conditional survival distribution, where premature mortality is concentrated. These findings support continued reductions in U.S. cadmium exposure and lead with particular benefit for adults most vulnerable to premature death.
papers.translated_summary: 摘要 背景。在美国一般人群中，长期低水平暴露于铅、镉、汞和砷仍然是过早死亡的决定因素，但此前的风险比分析未能刻画暴露如何改变生存分布的下尾，而过早死亡正集中于此。目的。我们估计了全血铅、全血总汞、尿镉以及尿无机砷和甲基化砷物种之和与美国40岁及以上成年人全因死亡随访时间的第10、第25和第50条件分位数的关联。方法。将1999至2018年NHANES连续数据与截至2019年12月31日的国家死亡指数链接（n = 29,652）。按金属在对数2尺度上拟合删失分位回归，分位数{tau}{0.10, 0.25, 0.50}。对血铅和尿镉拟合限制性立方样条（RCS）删失分位回归以探究阈值效应。结果。在中位随访9.1年期间，确认7,215例死亡。尿镉加倍与第10条件分位数随访时间减少1.57年相关（95% CI：-2.08, -1.07），第25分位数为-1.50（-2.04, -0.96），中位数为-1.49（-1.93, -1.04）（Benjamini Hochberg q < 0.001全程）。全血铅加倍与第10条件分位数减少0.70年相关（95% CI：-0.99, -0.40），第25分位数为-0.62（-0.92,-0.31），中位数为-0.61年（-0.89, -0.34）；两种金属的绝对损失均在{tau} = 0.10时最大。尿砷代谢物总和在可估计分位数上与条件随访时间无关。尽管调整了深色和脂肪鱼摄入或DHA/EPA，全血总汞仍与更长的随访时间相关（即与死亡风险负相关），可能由于更广泛饮食或社会经济因素的残余混杂，而非真正的保护效应。镉关联在相互调整铅后仍稳健。讨论。低至中度尿镉和全血铅与生存条件分位数下尾和中位数随访生存年数减少相关，绝对损失在条件生存分布下尾最大，而 premature mortality 正集中于此。这些发现支持继续降低美国镉暴露和铅暴露，尤其对最易发生过早死亡的成年人有益。

papers.title: HOW SAFE IS EXERCISE? CROSS-SECTIONAL ASSOCIATIONS OF CURRENT PHYSICAL ACTIVITY WITH SELF-REPORTED FRACTURE HISTORY IN MID-LIFE
papers.translated_title: 运动有多安全？当前体力活动与中年自报骨折史的横断面关联
papers.author: Rolls, C.
papers.summary: ObjectiveTo examine associations between the volume and intensity of leisure-time physical activity (LTPA) and fracture during mid-life, and whether adherence to World Health Organization (WHO) physical activity recommendations was associated with fracture. MethodsCross-sectional analysis of 322,749 UK Biobank participants aged 40-65 years using self-reported physical activity and fracture data. LTPA volume (LTPAv) was derived from walking, moderate and vigorous activity. Participants were categorised into LTPAv quintiles and by adherence to WHO physical activity recommendations. Multivariable logistic regression examined associations with self-reported fracture within the previous five years, with analyses stratified by sex and adjusted for sociodemographic and anthropometric factors. Walking, moderate and vigorous activity were mutually adjusted to examine associations by intensity. ResultsParticipants had a mean age of 47 years and 53% were female. Odds of fracture increased with higher LTPAv, although associations were non-linear and varied by age and sex. Associations were strongest in the highest quintile among men and women aged 40-49 years (OR 1.81, 95% CI 1.64-1.99 and OR 1.42, 95% CI 1.28-1.58, respectively). Vigorous activity demonstrated the strongest independent association with fracture. Meeting, without exceeding, WHO physical activity recommendations was not associated with increased odds of fracture. ConclusionsHigher LTPA volumes were associated with greater odds of fracture, particularly vigorous activity, with associations strongest in younger adults and men. Activity consistent with WHO recommendations was not associated with greater odds of fracture, supporting continued promotion of physical activity during mid-life.
papers.translated_summary: 目的探讨休闲时间体力活动（LTPA）的量与强度同中年期骨折之间的关联，以及遵守世界卫生组织（WHO）体力活动建议是否与骨折相关。方法对322，749名年龄40-65岁的英国生物银行参与者进行横断面分析，使用自我报告的体力活动和骨折数据。LTPA量（LTPAv）由步行、中等强度和高强度活动推算得出。参与者按LTPAv五分位数分组，并按是否遵守WHO体力活动建议分类。采用多变量logistic回归分析与过去五年内自我报告骨折的关联，分析按性别分层，并调整社会人口学和人体测量学因素。步行、中等强度和高强度活动相互调整以考察按强度的关联。结果参与者平均年龄47岁，53%为女性。骨折的比值比随LTPAv升高而增加，但关联呈非线性，并因年龄和性别而异。在40-49岁男性和女性中，最高五分位组的关联最强（OR 1.81，95% CI 1.64-1.99；OR 1.42，95% CI 1.28-1.58）。高强度活动与骨折的独立关联最强。达到但未超过WHO体力活动建议与骨折比值比增加无关。结论较高的LTPA量与更高的骨折比值比相关，尤其是高强度活动，且关联在年轻成人和男性中最强。符合WHO建议的活动与骨折比值比增加无关，支持继续促进中年期体力活动。

papers.title: Peripheral Predictors of Speech in Noise Deficits in a Population Cohort
papers.translated_title: 人群队列中言语噪声缺陷的外周预测因素
papers.author: Cederroth, C. R.
papers.summary: Background Age-related hearing loss is the leading sensory deficit in older adults, yet audiometric thresholds at conventional frequencies often poorly predict speech understanding. Two competing hypotheses have emerged: extended high-frequency (eHF) hearing loss beyond 8 kHz may unmask variance in speech performance, while cochlear synaptopathy, inferred via auditory brainstem response (ABR) wave I amplitude reduction, may degrade temporal coding independent of audiometry. This study aims to identify the best predictors of speech in noise deficits in the general population. Methods This is a cross-sectional analysis of 526 ears from 263 tinnitus-free adults (178 [67.7%] women and 85 men based on self-reported gender) enrolled in the Swedish Tinnitus Outreach Project, a population-based cohort study. Participants underwent air-conduction audiometry from 0.5 to 16 kHz, loudness discomfort levels, distortion product otoacoustic emissions, click-evoked ABR, and standardized speech-in-noise and word recognition testing in a clinical setting. Their associations with age and speech outcomes were evaluated using multivariable regression models. Results eHF pure-tone average was the most age-sensitive auditory metric, accounting for 64% of age-related variance, compared with 16% for PTA4 (the pure tone average of audiometric thresholds at 0.5, 1, 2, 4 kHz). eHF PTA thresholds (pure-tone average at 10-16 kHz) predicted speech-in-noise performance substantially better than PTA4, otoacoustic emissions, or ABR measures. ABR wave I amplitude did not significantly contribute to speech outcomes, even in high-reliability recordings (ICC = 0.96), whereas prolonged wave I latency was associated with poorer word recognition, particularly in older adults. In young adults, delayed wave I latency minimally affected word recognition, but in older adults an increase in latency from approximately 1.0 to 1.8 ms was associated with about a 27-percentage-point reduction in word recognition scores. Conclusions These findings identify eHF audiometry as a dominant clinical predictor of both cochlear aging and speech outcomes, and challenge the translational relevance of ABR-based synaptopathy markers in heterogeneous human populations, with implications for hearing assessment, clinical trials, and early intervention targeting in aging cohorts.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 年龄相关性听力损失是老年人最主要的感觉缺陷，然而常规频率的听阈往往难以准确预测言语理解能力。目前出现了两种相互竞争的假说：超过8 kHz的扩展高频（eHF）听力损失可能揭示言语表现的差异，而通过听性脑干反应（ABR）波I振幅降低推断的耳蜗突触病变，可能在独立于听力计检查的情况下损害时间编码。本研究旨在确定普通人群中噪声下言语缺陷的最佳预测指标。方法 本研究为横断面分析，纳入瑞典耳鸣外展项目（一项基于人群的队列研究）中263名无耳鸣成人（根据自我报告性别，178名[67.7%]女性和85名男性）的526只耳。参与者在临床环境中接受了0.5至16 kHz的气导听力计检查、不适阈水平测试、畸变产物耳声发射、短声诱发ABR以及标准化的噪声下言语和词语识别测试。采用多变量回归模型评估其与年龄和言语结局的关联。结果 eHF纯音平均听阈是对年龄最敏感的听觉指标，解释了64%的年龄相关方差，而PTA4（0.5、1、2、4 kHz听阈的纯音平均值）仅解释16%。eHF PTA阈值（10-16 kHz的纯音平均值）对噪声下言语表现的预测显著优于PTA4、耳声发射或ABR指标。ABR波I振幅对言语结局无显著贡献，即使在高可靠性记录中（ICC = 0.96）也是如此，而波I潜伏期延长与较差的词语识别相关，尤其是在老年人中。在年轻成人中，波I潜伏期延迟对词语识别的影响极小，但在老年人中，潜伏期从约1.0 ms增加至1.8 ms与词语识别得分降低约27个百分点相关。结论 这些发现表明eHF听力计检查是耳蜗老化和言语结局的主要临床预测指标，并质疑了基于ABR的突触病变标志物在异质性人群中的转化相关性，这对听力评估、临床试验以及老龄化队列中的早期干预靶向具有重要意义。

papers.title: Integrating GWAS meta-analysis with human brain cell mapping implicates the amygdala and cortical inhibitory interneurons in tinnitus
papers.translated_title: 将GWAS荟萃分析与人类脑细胞图谱相结合，揭示杏仁核和皮层抑制性中间神经元在耳鸣中的作用
papers.author: Schubert, N. M.
papers.summary: Purpose: Tinnitus is a common and heterogeneous condition whose genetic architecture remains poorly defined and whose definition varies across studies. We asked which common genetic variants are associated with tinnitus, to what extent genetic associations are shared across heterogeneous tinnitus definitions, and in which brain cell populations tinnitus heritability is concentrated. Methods: Genome-wide association meta-analysis of 19 independent population-based cohorts from Europe and the United States (hereby named EARGEN), comprising 961,085 adults of European ancestry (75,584 tinnitus cases and 885,501 controls). Tinnitus was defined by self-report in 17 cohorts and by diagnostic codes in two. Single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) based heritability and genetic correlations were estimated by linkage disequilibrium score regression, genes were mapped by gene-based association together with positional and expression quantitative trait locus mapping. Heritability enrichment was tested by stratified linkage disequilibrium score regression across 31 brain cell superclusters derived from post-mortem human brain donors, and across the 461 cell clusters that compose them. Enrichment was tested for replication in the Million Veteran Program (MVP) under a self-report definition (114,325 cases, 201,343 controls) and a diagnostic-code definition (77,601 cases, 310,953 controls). Results: Five independent loci reached genome-wide significance (p < 5 x 10-8) on chromosomes 2, 8, 12, 13 and 16, two of which (rs10877884 and rs2147632) have not been reported previously. SNP-based heritability was 0.0137 (SE = 0.0009) on the observed scale and 0.0535 (0.0036) on the liability scale. Genetic correlations were significant with hearing loss, anxiety disorder, major depressive disorder, chronic pain, and four further psychiatric, sleep and vestibular traits. Three superclusters showed a suggestive enrichment in the midbrain-derived inhibitory neurons, amygdala excitatory neurons, and medial ganglionic eminence interneurons at a false discovery rate (FRD) of 0.067, the two latter of which reached significance in the Million Veteran Program (MVP) under the diagnostic-code definition (0.030 and 0.006). At cluster resolution, the amygdala excitatory cluster was found significant (z = 4.82, false discovery rate = 3.3 x 10-4), whereas none of the ascending auditory relay cluster were found enriched (z [≤] 1.71, false discovery rate [≥] 0.21). Conclusion: Tinnitus-associated common variation concentrates in limbic and cortical neuronal populations rather than in the ascending auditory pathway. The predisposition to tinnitus therefore appears to be central and largely non-auditory in origin. The small number of genome-wide significant associations obtained despite a large sample emphasizes the need for more detailed and standardized phenotyping focusing on the tinnitus disorder.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：耳鸣是一种常见且异质性较高的疾病，其遗传结构仍不明确，且不同研究对其定义存在差异。我们旨在探究哪些常见遗传变异与耳鸣相关，遗传关联在不同耳鸣定义之间的共享程度，以及耳鸣遗传力集中于哪些脑细胞群体。方法：对来自欧洲和美国的19个独立人群队列（以下称为EARGEN）进行全基因组关联荟萃分析，共纳入961，085名欧洲血统成年人（75，584例耳鸣病例和885，501例对照）。耳鸣在17个队列中通过自我报告定义，在2个队列中通过诊断代码定义。基于单核苷酸多态性（SNP）的遗传力和遗传相关性通过连锁不平衡得分回归估计，基因通过基于基因的关联分析结合位置映射和表达数量性状基因座映射进行定位。遗传力富集通过分层连锁不平衡得分回归在来自死后人脑供体的31个脑细胞超级簇及其组成的461个细胞簇中进行检验。富集在百万退伍军人计划（MVP）中通过自我报告定义（114，325例病例，201，343例对照）和诊断代码定义（77，601例病例，310，953例对照）进行重复验证。结果：五个独立位点在2、8、12、13和16号染色体上达到全基因组显著性（p < 5 x 10-8），其中两个位点（rs10877884和rs2147632）此前未见报道。基于SNP的遗传力在观测尺度上为0.0137（SE = 0.0009），在易患性尺度上为0.0535（0.0036）。遗传相关性在听力损失、焦虑障碍、重度抑郁症、慢性疼痛以及另外四个精神、睡眠和前庭性状中显著。三个超级簇在中脑来源的抑制性神经元、杏仁核兴奋性神经元和内侧神经节隆起中间神经元中显示出提示性富集，错误发现率（FDR）为0.067，其中后两者在百万退伍军人计划（MVP）诊断代码定义下达到显著性（0.030和0.006）。在细胞簇分辨率下，杏仁核兴奋性簇被发现显著（z = 4.82，错误发现率 = 3.3 x 10-4），而上升听觉 relay 簇均未发现富集（z [&le；] 1.71，错误发现率 [&ge；] 0.21）。结论：耳鸣相关的常见变异集中于边缘系统和皮层神经元群体，而非上升听觉通路。因此，耳鸣的易感性似乎是中枢性的，且在很大程度上非听觉起源。尽管样本量很大，但获得的全基因组显著关联数量较少，这强调需要更详细和标准化的表型分析，聚焦于耳鸣障碍。

papers.title: Trends in Cardiovascular Risk Factors, Disease Management, and Predicted Cardiovascular Risk Among US Adults, 1999-2023
papers.translated_title: 1999-2023年美国成年人心血管危险因素、疾病管理及预测心血管风险的趋势
papers.author: Ahmed, H. M.
papers.summary: Background: Cardiovascular risk factors have changed in the United States, but trends in prevalence, management, and predicted risk through the post-pandemic period remain incompletely characterized. Methods: We analyzed 11 National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) periods (1999-2000 through 2021-2023) among 60,199 nonpregnant adults aged 20 years. Survey-weighted regression assessed age-standardized trends, subgroup differences, and measurement-change sensitivity. We assessed awareness, treatment, and control of hypertension, dyslipidemia, and diabetes. PREVENT equations estimated 10- and 30-year risks among adults without self-reported cardiovascular disease (CVD). Results: Obesity increased from 47.4% to 57.2% (odds ratio [OR] per decade, 1.23; 95% CI, 1.16-1.30), with class III obesity more than doubling (4.7% to 9.7%). Diabetes increased from 8.2% to 12.7% (OR, 1.26; 95% CI, 1.19-1.34), while current smoking declined from 24.4% to 14.9% (OR, 0.76; 95% CI, 0.71-0.81). Hypertension, dyslipidemia, chronic kidney disease, and prior CVD showed no significant linear trends, although mean systolic blood pressure (BP) (124.2 to 120.2 mm Hg) and total cholesterol (203.6 to 188.1 mg/dL) declined, alongside improvements in other lipids. Hypertension and dyslipidemia awareness and treatment increased, but BP control peaked at 32.5% in 2013-2014 before declining to 21.5%, while LDL cholesterol control rose from 17.0% to 34.2%. Diabetes awareness increased, but treatment trends were nonsignificant. Glycemic control peaked at 51.2% in 2003-2004 before declining to 41.9% (P for nonlinearity <0.001). Predicted 10-year total CVD risk declined from 5.66% to 5.28%; atherosclerotic CVD (ASCVD) risk declined by 0.16 percentage points per decade (95% CI, 0.22 to 0.09), while heart failure (HF) risk increased by 0.10 (95% CI, 0.03-0.17). Their 2021-2023 estimates were nearly identical (3.20% and 3.19%, respectively); 30-year risks showed similar divergence. Conclusions: Improvements in smoking, blood pressure, and lipids coexisted with rising obesity and diabetes, declining blood pressure control after earlier gains, and divergent predicted ASCVD and HF risks.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：美国的心血管危险因素已发生变化，但大流行后时期的患病率、管理和预测风险趋势仍未得到充分描述。方法：我们分析了11个美国国家健康与营养调查（NHANES）周期（1999-2000年至2021-2023年）中60,199名年龄20岁的非妊娠成年人。调查加权回归评估了年龄标准化趋势、亚组差异和测量变化敏感性。我们评估了高血压、血脂异常和糖尿病的知晓率、治疗率和控制率。PREVENT方程估算了无自报心血管疾病（CVD）成年人的10年和30年风险。结果：肥胖率从47.4%上升至57.2%（每十年比值比[OR]为1.23；95% CI，1.16-1.30），III级肥胖增加了一倍以上（4.7%至9.7%）。糖尿病从8.2%上升至12.7%（OR，1.26；95% CI，1.19-1.34），而当前吸烟率从24.4%下降至14.9%（OR，0.76；95% CI，0.71-0.81）。高血压、血脂异常、慢性肾脏病和既往CVD未显示显著的线性趋势，尽管平均收缩压（BP）（124.2至120.2 mm Hg）和总胆固醇（203.6至188.1 mg/dL）下降，同时其他血脂指标也有所改善。高血压和血脂异常的知晓率和治疗率增加，但血压控制率在2013-2014年达到32.5%的峰值后下降至21.5%，而LDL胆固醇控制率从17.0%上升至34.2%。糖尿病知晓率增加，但治疗趋势不显著。血糖控制率在2003-2004年达到51.2%的峰值后下降至41.9%（非线性P<0.001）。预测的10年总CVD风险从5.66%下降至5.28%；动脉粥样硬化性CVD（ASCVD）风险每十年下降0.16个百分点（95% CI，0.22至0.09），而心力衰竭（HF）风险增加0.10（95% CI，0.03-0.17）。其2021-2023年估计值几乎相同（分别为3.20%和3.19%）；30年风险显示出类似的分化。结论：吸烟、血压和血脂的改善与肥胖和糖尿病的上升并存，血压控制率在早期改善后下降，以及预测的ASCVD和HF风险出现分化。

papers.title: Elevated HbA1c is associated with advanced brain age in severe obesity
papers.translated_title: 在严重肥胖中，HbA1c升高与大脑年龄提前相关
papers.author: Juhasz, J.
papers.summary: Introduction: Brain-predicted age, estimated from structural MRI data, is a machine-learning biomarker of biological brain aging. Greater brain age gap (BAG) indicates advanced brain aging and is associated with cognitive decline and mortality. Cardiometabolic risk factors, including elevated blood glucose, body mass index (BMI), blood pressure, and cholesterol, increase risk of cognitive impairment and dementia in aging. Their relationship with BAG in severe obesity remains poorly characterized despite increased prevalence of cardiometabolic risk factors among this population. Methods: T1-weighted MRI data from 97 adults (BMI 35-73) were used to calculate BAG using ENIGMA and Pyment brain age models. Associations between BAG and HbA1c, BMI, hypertension, and hyperlipidemia were examined using multiple linear regression and MM-estimation robust regression, adjusting for age, sex, and race. Post hoc analyses stratified models by clinical HbA1c cutoffs (normoglycemic, prediabetic, diabetic). Results: Higher HbA1c was associated with greater BAGENIGMA (B = 1.58, p = .014) and BAGPyment (B = 0.93, p = .013) in linear regression models. In robust models, HbA1c remained significantly associated with BAGENIGMA (B = 1.70, p = .002) but not BAGPyment (B = 0.71, p = .13). BMI, hypertension, and hyperlipidemia were not associated with BAG in either linear or robust models. HbA1c was associated with greater BAGENIGMA (B = 2.15, p = .01) and BAGPyment (B =1.21, p = .04) in those at or above prediabetic levels and with BAGENIGMA (B = 2.49, p = .047) in those with diabetes. Conclusions: Elevated HbA1c is associated with accelerated brain aging in individuals with severe obesity. BAG was not associated with BMI, hypertension, and hyperlipidemia, which may reflect the restricted BMI range inherent to the sample with severe obesity.
papers.translated_summary: 引言：通过结构MRI数据估算的大脑预测年龄是一种反映大脑生物学衰老的机器学习生物标志物。较大的脑龄差（BAG）表明大脑衰老加速，并与认知功能下降和死亡率相关。心脏代谢危险因素，包括血糖升高、体重指数（BMI）、血压和胆固醇升高，会增加衰老过程中认知障碍和痴呆的风险。尽管重度肥胖人群中这些心脏代谢危险因素的患病率增加，但其与BAG的关系仍鲜有明确描述。方法：使用来自97名成年人（BMI 35-73）的T1加权MRI数据，通过ENIGMA和Pyment大脑年龄模型计算BAG。采用多元线性回归和MM估计稳健回归检验BAG与HbA1c、BMI、高血压和高脂血症之间的关联，并校正年龄、性别和种族。事后分析按临床HbA1c截断值（血糖正常、糖尿病前期、糖尿病）对模型进行分层。结果：在线性回归模型中，较高的HbA1c与较大的BAGENIGMA（B = 1.58，p = .014）和BAGPyment（B = 0.93，p = .013）相关。在稳健模型中，HbA1c仍与BAGENIGMA显著相关（B = 1.70，p = .002），但与BAGPyment不相关（B = 0.71，p = .13）。BMI、高血压和高脂血症在线性或稳健模型中均与BAG无关。在处于或高于糖尿病前期水平者中，HbA1c与较大的BAGENIGMA（B = 2.15，p = .01）和BAGPyment（B = 1.21，p = .04）相关；在糖尿病患者中，HbA1c与BAGENIGMA相关（B = 2.49，p = .047）。结论：HbA1c升高与重度肥胖个体的大脑衰老加速相关。BAG与BMI、高血压和高脂血症无关，这可能反映了重度肥胖样本固有的BMI范围受限。
